paragraphs: This is how Mar bar Rav Ashi signed his name; see his entry.[^1]

notes.text: The heading labels Tavyomi an epithet; the body says Mar bar Rav Ashi signed himself thus. Both Mar and Rav are explicit. The cross-reference remains textual, without an authority merge or an independently bound target.
